from pathlib import Path
import difflib,hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd(); task=Path("reports/T0007"); out=task/"review-r1-freeze"
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
planned=json.loads((task/"planning-final-check/final-audit.json").read_text())
allow={"README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md"}
for p,h in base["tracked_sha256"].items():
    if p not in allow|{"docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md"}: assert sha(p)==h,p
for p,h in planned["artifact_sha256"].items():
    if p not in allow: assert sha(p)==h,p
inputs=["src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py","tests/test_dependency.py","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","reports/T0007/pi-r1-full/provenance.md","reports/T0007/pi-r1-full-doctor.json","reports/T0007/record_check.py","docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md"]
hashes={}
for p in inputs:
    dest=out/"input-snapshot"/p
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(Path(p).read_bytes())
    hashes[p]=sha(p)
assert hashes[inputs[0]]=="4b01df6f08e243c649f0459a23e6e8a68f946fc0eec41814f889e65cd972ca3f"
assert hashes[inputs[1]]=="a4e428e9d1acc99a7dc3e01e725e7b3da8d009c8f1c39eeac957b8dd57d7e09c"
records=[]
for p in sorted(task.glob("pi-*/record.json")):
    rec=json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished",p
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"],p
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"): assert sha(p.parent/(stream+".txt"))==rec[stream+"_sha256"],(p,stream)
    for name,h in rec["before"]["source_sha256"].items():
        if name in inputs[:2] and p.parent.name=="pi-r1-preflight":
            assert h is None
        else: assert sha(name)==h,(p,name)
    records.append({"run":p.parent.name,**{k:rec[k] for k in ("argv","env_overrides","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")},
                    "stderr_empty":not (p.parent/"stderr.txt").read_bytes()})
assert len(records)==6
history={str(p):sha(p) for p in Path("reports").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "pytest-tmp" not in p.parts and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and not str(p).startswith("reports/T0007/review-r1")}
doc=json.loads((task/"pi-r1-full-doctor.json").read_text())
audit={"head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
"branch":subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip(),
"input_sha256":hashes,"history_sha256":history,"pi_records":records,
"old_tracked_files_and_frozen_planning_unchanged":True,
"doctor_report":{"torch":doc["packages"]["torch"],"status":doc["status"],"generated_at_utc":doc["generated_at_utc"]},
"pending_record_findings":["No Pi pytest argv includes required --basetemp; full added unrelated doctor call.",
"Archived doctor uses CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; GPU fluctuation explanation unsupported.",
"Provenance torch version 2.9.1+cu128 conflicts with archived report 2.10.0+cu126.",
"Three later doctor successes have no archived RUN in supplied report tree; RUN rename is self-reported."]}
(out/"audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
(out/"readme-status.diff").write_text(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md"],text=True))
print(f"PASS: exact input hashes, {len(records)} Pi RUN log hashes/source snapshots, old tracked/planning files unchanged")
print(f"Frozen {len(history)} historical files.")
for rec in records:
    print(rec["run"],"exit="+str(rec["exit_code"]),"elapsed_s="+str(rec["elapsed_s"]),"stderr_empty="+str(rec["stderr_empty"]))
print("Archived doctor:",json.dumps(audit["doctor_report"]))
